## Home

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-3}

::: {.g-col-12 .g-col-md-9 style="text-align: justify;"}
Rui Asano/淺野塁 is an associate professor in the Faculty of Law at Seinan Gakuin University, Fukuoka, Japan. I received a Ph.D. in political science from Waseda University. My research focuses primarily on United Nations peacekeeping, with broader interests in peacebuilding in West African countries and other areas of internatioanl relations. My current research examines where peacekeepers are deployed and when peacekeepers complete their planned tasks.
:::

<script>
function copyEmail() {
  const parts = ["ruiasano", "seinan-gu", "ac", "jp"];
  const email = parts[0] + "@" + parts[1] + "." + parts[2] + "." + parts[3];

  navigator.clipboard.writeText(email).then(() => {
    const label = document.getElementById("email-button-text");
    label.textContent = "Copied!";
    setTimeout(() => {
      label.textContent = "Email";
    }, 1500);
  });
}
</script>
